title: AgentFund Milestone Crowdfunding
summary: Crowdfund an AI agent project and release the money milestone by milestone only when backers vote yes.
what: AgentFund is three Anchor 0.30.1 programs: a registry of agents and projects, a milestone escrow governed by backer votes, and a reputation score kept by the platform.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentfund/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console for the escrow program. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/AgentFund; only the three declare_id values changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentfund/, switch to Devnet and read an escrow account, or contribute SOL to a project you created through the registry.
try_steps.see: Escrow totals, milestone index and status.
try_steps.ran: Two campaigns: full milestone release and a missed-deadline refund (see steps).

diagram: creator --register_agent/create_project--> registry; creator --initialize_escrow (terms checked)--> escrow; backers --contribute--> escrow; backers --vote_milestone--> votes; anyone --release_milestone(votes > 50%)--> creator; after deadline (goal missed) backer --refund
accounts: project PDA ["project", creator, index u32 LE] (registry)
innovation: Escrow terms are bound to the registry project on chain, and each milestone needs a contribution-weighted majority, so a creator cannot change the deal or take the money early.
exercises: Why does release_milestone take vote accounts as remaining accounts?
What happens to backers who never vote?
